en: Vintage, monochrome postcard depicting a tree‑lined driveway leading to a large hotel building partially visible in the background. There are tall leafy trees, street lamps with overhead wires, benches, and a terrace with tables and chairs in front of the hotel. The scene looks like the entrance area of a grand hotel set in a wooded park. Text is printed in the lower left corner.
